summary:
fix(git): reject unfollowed dynamic import callers
Owning regressions pass; a new real E3 escape and native-backed full-tree acceptance require Lead follow-up.
commandNotation: $E is evidenceDirectory; $scratch is an invocation-owned mktemp directory under /tmp/fgos-work/scanner-dynamic-import.XXXXXX, removed after each invocation. Command groups preserve all executed shell operations; tool read/grep operations have no process exit code.

impactAnalysis.reason: The brief prohibits fgos CLI, including the capability query; no GitNexus MCP tools are exposed. Call graph is not independently confirmed.

git log --oneline -G 'importersOf|computeValueFlow|await.*import' -- scripts/git-one-door-scan.mjs && git show d0dcc24ec --stat && git show 2fa7fe921 -- scripts/git-one-door-scan.mjs

fullTreeAcceptance.reason: The CLI unconditionally opens native Inspect; its bootstrap may build/stage outside the grant, and skill YAML parsing also needs the native door. No addons or bootstrap writes are permitted. Lead must run the full scan without --write-census in the staged environment.

newSite.recommendation: Lead should change the three E3 inline imports to already followed awaited namespace/destructured bindings, then rerun the full gate. No current declaration targets this site; a permissive declaration cannot safely override the export escapes.
